facts.fact: Seminar participants (SPIN, Ageos, Aninf, ministry) said Gabon will build on 2,000 km of optical fibre already deployed; no places, regions or lit status are given.
The same report says extension works on the national fibre are under way; no contract, route or contractor is given.

note: In-service fact is weak: 'deployed' not 'lit', no places named.
